messages.snippet: Charles, Great to be working with you again on Project Drake, the proposed acquisition of Tidewell M
messages.subject: Project Drake — engagement and kick-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Charles,

Great to be working with you again on Project Drake, the proposed acquisition of Tidewell Marina Holdings. I attach our engagement letter for WC-00148. As discussed, James Osei will run the deal day-to-day with Elena Marchetti, and I will supervise.

On current scope and an enterprise value around £24.5m we estimate £120k–£155k plus VAT to completion. Please sign and return the enclosed copy at your convenience.

Best,
Sarah

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Sarah,

Signed copy to follow from Priya. Nathan will be your main point of contact on our side. Keen to move quickly while we have exclusivity — Gregory Tidewell is motivated but wants certainty.

Charles
